rules.name: typescript/no-explicit-any
rules.rationale: Prevents agents from bypassing TypeScript with explicit any annotations.

rules.name: typescript/no-non-null-assertion
rules.rationale: Forces nullable values to be handled instead of asserted away.

rules.name: typescript/no-unsafe-assignment
rules.rationale: Stops any-typed values from leaking into typed variables and properties.

rules.name: typescript/no-unsafe-call
rules.rationale: Prevents calling any-typed values that may not be functions.

rules.name: typescript/no-unsafe-member-access
rules.rationale: Prevents property access on any-typed values that can fail at runtime.

rules.name: typescript/no-floating-promises
rules.rationale: Forces promises to be awaited, returned, or explicitly handled.

rules.name: typescript/no-misused-promises
rules.rationale: Catches promises used where a boolean, void callback, or plain value was expected.

rules.name: typescript/switch-exhaustiveness-check
rules.rationale: Forces every union case to be handled when switch statements evolve.

rules.name: eslint/no-empty
rules.rationale: Prevents empty blocks and catch handlers from hiding unfinished error handling.

rules.name: eslint/no-unused-vars
rules.rationale: Catches dead declarations left behind by incomplete edits.

rules.name: eslint/no-unused-expressions
rules.rationale: Flags expressions that do nothing and often indicate a mistaken edit.

rules.name: eslint/no-constant-condition
rules.rationale: Catches always-true or always-false branches that hide logic mistakes.

rules.name: import/no-cycle
rules.rationale: Prevents circular imports that can produce undefined values at runtime.

rules.name: import/named
rules.rationale: Catches imports and re-exports that reference names a module does not provide.
